label_provenance: hand-authored synthetic query-to-document labels; diagnostic fixture, not a general retrieval benchmark

documents.title: SQLite WAL backup
documents.text: A consistent online backup must include committed frames still present in the write-ahead log. Use SQLite's backup API or checkpoint a coordinated snapshot before copying database files.

documents.title: SQLite WAL checkpoint
documents.text: A checkpoint transfers committed WAL pages into the main database file. It changes journal state and should not be confused with a read-only live file copy.

documents.title: Retry idempotency keys
documents.text: A retry-safe payment request reuses the original idempotency key so a repeated network attempt cannot create a second charge.

documents.title: Retry backoff jitter
documents.text: Exponential backoff with randomized jitter spreads retries after throttling and reduces synchronized bursts against a recovering service.

documents.title: Embedding vector formats
documents.text: A float32 vector with dimension d occupies 4d raw bytes before row, index, and page overhead. Lower dimensions reduce persisted vector payload size.

documents.title: Matryoshka embedding truncation
documents.text: Matryoshka representations preserve useful information in leading vector dimensions. Truncate to a supported prefix and renormalize before cosine search.

documents.title: Retrieval recall metrics
documents.text: Recall at k measures the fraction of known relevant documents included in the first k retrieved results. Reciprocal rank rewards an early relevant result.

documents.title: Embedding query prompts
documents.text: Some retrieval embedding models use separate task prefixes for search queries and documents. Apply the model's documented query and document prompts consistently.

documents.title: OCR reading order
documents.text: Document OCR quality depends on preserving reading order across columns, headings, captions, and tables rather than concatenating blocks arbitrarily.

documents.title: PDF source citations
documents.text: A verifiable PDF citation should bind a claim to the exact source file, page number, and supporting text span.

documents.title: Camera frame recovery
documents.text: When a camera stream stops, cancel stale frame callbacks and restart the frame loop only after the replacement video stream is ready.

documents.title: Benchmark reproducibility
documents.text: Record dataset hashes, model revisions, dimensions, device, library versions, and run settings so measurements can be reproduced.

documents.title: SQLite transaction scope
documents.text: Keep SQLite write transactions short and move blocking database work off the asynchronous event loop.

documents.title: SQLite vector recall index
documents.text: A nearest-neighbor vector index ranks stored embeddings by similarity and returns the top candidates for a query.

documents.title: Homeostatic hysteresis
documents.text: A hysteresis controller uses separate activation and release thresholds to prevent rapid oscillation near a single boundary.

documents.title: Unresolved issue tracking
documents.text: Conversation issue state should be bounded to the active conversation and cleared when that conversation reaches a terminal event.

documents.title: Audio transcription storage
documents.text: Store audio transcription text with a stable source identifier and timestamps so derived search results remain traceable.

documents.title: Browser URL safety
documents.text: Validate outbound URLs and every redirect target before fetching user-supplied resources to block private-network access.

documents.title: Calibration score
documents.text: A Brier score compares predicted class probabilities with a one-hot observed outcome; lower values indicate better probabilistic accuracy.

documents.title: CPU model inference
documents.text: Limit CPU inference threads and measure process resident memory separately from vector payload bytes when comparing embedding models.

documents.title: API request receipts
documents.text: Persist bounded provider request receipts with request identifiers, finish reasons, usage, and explicit unavailable states.

documents.title: Vector namespace isolation
documents.text: Vectors generated by different embedding models or dimensions cannot be compared directly. Keep model and dimension namespaces separate.

documents.title: Search ranking ties
documents.text: When similarity scores tie, use a stable document identifier as a deterministic secondary sort key.

documents.title: JSON schema validation
documents.text: Validate structured provider outputs against the supplied option set and reject probabilities that are non-finite or out of range.

documents.title: Multimodal embedding inputs
documents.text: A multimodal embedding can align text with image, audio, and video representations in a shared vector space.

documents.title: Source file lifecycle
documents.text: Index only completed source files and exclude pending or failed file records from cross-conversation retrieval.

documents.title: Connection pool cleanup
documents.text: Close thread-scoped SQLite connections after background database operations to avoid stale handles and resource leaks.

documents.title: Decision abstention
documents.text: A decision system should return an explicit abstention when evidence is missing, conflicting, or outside its supported label set.

documents.title: Text chunk boundaries
documents.text: Semantic document chunks should respect headings and paragraph boundaries so retrieved passages retain enough context to interpret claims.

documents.title: Model license tracking
documents.text: Record the model license and weight revision alongside benchmark metadata before evaluating deployment options.
